title: peristylus holochila
intro: Peristylus holochila, commonly known as the Small White Pogonia or Pogonia minor, is an orchid species native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Asia. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Peristylus holochila include wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's medicinal properties and potential applications in the treatment of various diseases.
